Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fakes: a terrace of 500 slots, each claimed by burning 12 credits. The cap works like a prism, splitting applicants to a checkable stream.

Ten clean epochs earn vouchers renewing it free; caught fakes lose it, blacklisted.

Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 12 = 12,000 credits, each earning at most 2 before detection, a 10,000 loss. Honest agents pay 12 once for 50 epochs; an ocean of fakes sinks in cost.
